submitted.rationale: XRD shows single-phase NiSb2O6-type trirutile from roughly 0.3 to 0.5 Sb. A NiO impurity (Q≈3.01) appears at 0.16 Sb, and an Sb-oxide second phase (Q≈2.46, 3.65, 1.90) appears at 0.66 Sb and above. Of the three EQE measurements, index 16 (Ni0.49Sb0.51, phase-pure trirutile) gave the highest value, 0.030%. Index 8 gave 0.014% and index 24 gave 0.009%.

rejected.reason: Measured EQE of 0.0138%, lower than index 16; this is the Ni-rich side approaching the NiO-containing region
Measured EQE of 0.0090%; lies in the Sb-rich region with an Sb-oxide second phase
NiO is wide-gap and gives no benefit at 2.1 eV; EQE was falling toward the Ni-rich side
